nodes.label: No MDS in sandboxed iframe
nodes.rationale: The front-end runs in a sandboxed iframe with no MDS access, so it loads catalog data and installs dapps via the PocketWeb parent postMessage proxy (miniweb_*) rather than calling MDS directly.

nodes.label: Time-lock stakes
nodes.rationale: Locks MINIMA so it can only be spent after a chosen date/block; enforced by the blockchain so nobody — not even the owner — can unlock early.

nodes.label: Guardian background daemon
nodes.rationale: Runs as a background daemon with the node, checking stakes on every new block and collecting matured ones unattended.

nodes.label: Collect flow
nodes.rationale: Matured safe stakes are auto-collected (given a fresh audit under 30 min); each stake also has manual Collect now, and the Guardian tab has Collect all now.

nodes.label: Stake maturity (Pending/Matured)
nodes.rationale: A stake sits under Pending with a countdown until its unlock date, then moves to Matured where the Guardian collects it.

nodes.label: WOTS key-reuse protection
nodes.rationale: Minima signs with one-time (WOTS) keys that weaken on reuse; Future Cash audits keys and, for stakes landing on reused addresses, immediately sweeps them to a safe wallet before an attacker can exploit the reused key.

nodes.label: Key audit service
nodes.rationale: Sends only public keys/addresses to an external service to detect key reuse; a fresh audit (under 30 min) is required for automatic safe collecting, and an incomplete audit pauses auto-collect for safety.

nodes.label: WRITE vs READ mode
nodes.rationale: The daemon must act unattended, so Future Cash requires WRITE mode; in READ mode actions get stuck as pending requests that cannot be approved by hand — a Minima safety rule only the user can grant.

nodes.label: Rescue / Harden (at-risk sweep)
nodes.rationale: For at-risk stakes the Guardian quick-sweeps to a clean address or hands off to AnyPhraseRecovery for full seed migration; the Harden panel sweeps and retires reused change addresses so fresh money stops landing on them.

nodes.label: Classic Future Cash 2.7.1
nodes.rationale: A fully manual alternative with no background daemon and no key-reuse protection, offered for users who prefer manual control.

nodes.label: PandaDapps IPFS Store Front-End
nodes.rationale: Gateway-agnostic IPFS store front-end adapted from the PocketWeb pandadapps-site but with NO MDS/PocketWeb coupling — uses plain browser fetch() and relative catalog paths so it works at any IPFS gateway or raw /ipfs/<CID>/ path.

nodes.label: PandaDapps tab

nodes.label: Minima Official tab
nodes.rationale: Tab id 'official', reads key 'dapps' from store/minimadapps.json; official MiniDapps mirror.

nodes.label: Android APKs tab
nodes.rationale: Tab id 'apks', reads key 'apps' from apks/apks.json; native minimaCore apps — sideload.

nodes.label: pandadapps.json catalog
nodes.rationale: Relative catalog JSON consumed by PandaDapps tab; items under 'dapps' key.

nodes.label: store/minimadapps.json catalog
nodes.rationale: Relative catalog JSON consumed by Official tab; has the string-or-array 'description' quirk handled by normDesc.

nodes.label: apks/apks.json catalog

nodes.label: selectTab() fetch+state
nodes.rationale: Sets ACTIVE tab, applies accent CSS vars, uses CACHE, fetch()es t.src, extracts data[t.key], calls render(); shows retry on error.

nodes.label: render() card builder
nodes.rationale: Builds the dapp-grid of cards, renders download-only buttons (local Download vs remote External download), surfaces sha256 hash and category badge, no install path.

nodes.label: normDesc() string-or-array normalizer
nodes.rationale: Handles minimadapps.json quirk where description is a string OR array of strings; joins arrays with a space.

nodes.label: Download-only buttons
nodes.rationale: No install path — runs on a bare gateway with no Minima node; local files use download attr, remote http(s) files open External download in a new tab.

nodes.label: PocketWeb pandadapps-site front-end
nodes.rationale: The MDS/PocketWeb-coupled store front-end this IPFS page was adapted from — same store UI, different execution context (node/MDS present).

nodes.label: AnyDappStore front-end (PocketWeb mini-site)
nodes.rationale: Generic universal MiniDapp-store installer front-end; user pastes any store JSON URL to browse and install dapps. Structurally near-identical to the PandaDapps store front-end (same miniweb_* proxy pattern, render/installDapp/semver logic), differing mainly in that the catalog URL is user-supplied rather than hardcoded — hence semantically_similar_to pandadapps_site_index_front at INFERRED ~0.85.

nodes.label: User-supplied store catalog JSON (name/description/dapps[])
nodes.rationale: Catalog schema is {name, description, dapps:[{name,version,description,icon,file}]}, matching the pandadapps.json store format; URL entered at runtime via the LOAD url-bar rather than hardcoded.
